_comment: Known war.gov/UFO (PURSUE program) data releases and mirror status. The site ingests a release once DenisSergeevitch/UFO-USA mirrors its PDFs (war.gov blocks our IPs). 'mirrored' releases are live in the corpus; 'pending-mirror' releases are surfaced as 'incoming' on the site and picked up automatically when corpus:sync sees the upstream manifest grow. Edit here; the next build of public/work-available.json reflects changes.
